title: Capture Session Metadata V1
description: Metadata object uploaded by an RK3588 edge integration for one medication preparation capture session. Server-side CameraSet configuration remains authoritative.

camera_set_id.description: Exact immutable CameraSet version provisioned by the platform to the edge integration.

expected_camera_count.description: Edge observation that must equal the enabled-member count in the server CameraSet.

device_time_utc.description: Device UTC time declared when the metadata manifest was produced; it is not a substitute for media PTS.

device_timezone.description: IANA or fixed-offset ZoneId validated by the platform, for example Asia/Shanghai or UTC+08:00.

client_file_id.description: Client file ID of one VIDEO entry in the same completed upload batch.

camera_channel_id.description: Immutable logical channel ID provisioned by the platform.

enabled.description: Must be true and match an enabled member of the immutable server CameraSet for an uploaded video stream.

record_start_utc.description: Edge-declared recording start time. Media probing later records authoritative container and stream timing.

time_offset_ms.description: Signed edge-declared offset observation. It does not become a verified synchronization revision automatically.

sync_status.description: Edge-declared synchronization observation, retained separately from later platform quality decisions.
